name: Edge information

subjectOf.text: Information in decentralized systems originates at the edges and is optimized through feedback: peers who receive information transmit its changed relevance back to the original generator, who evaluates and amends it, constantly updating and optimizing information quality.
subjectOf.abstract: This feedback constantly updates and optimizes the quality of infor- mation.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Preface to (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782191
